user.title: Connect Hagleitner Community
user.description: Enter the Azure Service Bus queue details. The connection string is stored in Home Assistant's configuration, so protect your backups.

confirm.title: New Hagleitner device
confirm.description: Add {name} to Home Assistant? HSM location path: {location_path}. HSM mount point: {mount_point}. A dash (—) means HSM did not provide that value. The device and its entities are created only after you confirm. If an existing Home Assistant area matches the innermost device location, it is suggested below and can be changed.

error_active.title: {device_name}: error active
error_active.description: {resource_name} reports an active error (resource type {resource_type_id}). Check the device for details.

connection_offline.title: {device_name}: offline
connection_offline.description: {resource_name} reports that the device is offline.

flowmeter_replacement.title: {device_name}: replace flowmeter
flowmeter_replacement.description: The flowmeter has reached its volume-based replacement threshold. Replace it and reset the flowmeter change action to clear this task.

pump_replacement.title: {device_name}: replace pump
pump_replacement.description: A time- or volume-based pump replacement threshold has been reached. Replace the pump and reset its change action to clear this task.

error.queue_already_configured_disabled: This queue is already added but disabled. Enable the existing entry instead of adding another.
